experiments.hypothesis: Overlapping source-resolution driver ROI tiles preserve small-phone pixels and produce correctly mapped, deduplicated proposals with a frozen detector.
experiments.risk: More tiles increase latency and can increase negative-frame proposals.

experiments.hypothesis: The 13 development false negatives are jointly dominated by specialist detector misses, unknown driver association, and action evidence below the frozen gate.
experiments.risk: FN-selected evidence cannot estimate population precision or new false positives.

experiments.hypothesis: Unknown driver or handheld context must remain NEEDS_REVIEW/UNKNOWN so candidate preservation does not become an unverified violation or SAFE decision.
experiments.risk: Coverage may remain low until occupant-role labels exist.
